common.disclaimer: AI assistant · not an official government channel

home.headline: From confusion to action on government services
home.sub: Tell me your situation in English, Hindi or Hinglish. I'll show what may apply, with official sources.
home.scope: Now covering Delhi: income certificate, SC/ST/OBC merit scholarship and old-age pension.

chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.suggestion2: I'm a student in Delhi, family income about 3 lakh
chat.suggestion3: My mother is 67, can she get a pension?

card.notApproval: Based on what you told me. Not an approval.

consent.title: Save these details for next time?
consent.body: I'll keep only what you confirmed, never ID numbers. You can delete everything any time.
consent.saved: Saved. You can delete it any time.

compare.title: Compare services
compare.error: I couldn't load this. Please try again.

panel.title: Your details
panel.empty: Details you confirm in the chat appear here. Only you see them.
panel.notSaved: Not saved. It disappears when you close the chat.

docs.title: Document check
docs.sub: Pick a service, add the documents you have, and see what is still missing. Only fields you confirm are saved. The file itself is never stored.
docs.caption: Based on your checklist. Not a prediction of approval.
docs.scanned: Read from your upload and confirmed by you
docs.declared: You said you have it. Not checked
docs.hide: Hide personal details you do not need to share before uploading a photo. Identity numbers are shown only as the last 4 digits.
docs.reviewHelp: Correct anything that is wrong, then confirm.
docs.saveError: Could not save. Please try again.
docs.loadError: Could not load. Please try again.
docs.find_unreadable: We could not read this document. Try a clearer photo.
docs.find_blurry: The photo looks blurry. A sharper photo gives better results.
docs.find_low_resolution: The photo is small. A larger photo gives better results.
docs.find_missing_field: We could not find: {field}. Please fill it in.
docs.err_too_large: That file is too large (max 8 MB).
docs.err_unsupported_type: Use a JPG, PNG or PDF file.
docs.err_corrupt_file: That file could not be opened.
docs.err_ocr_unavailable: Reading documents is not available right now.
docs.err_unknown_doc_type: That document type is not supported.
docs.err_other: Could not read the file. Please try again.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.sub: Prepare a complaint, an RTI application or a grievance draft. Nothing is sent anywhere. You review every field, then download a PDF.
drafts.complaint: Complaint about a delayed or refused service
drafts.f_bpl: I am a Below Poverty Line applicant
drafts.hide: Do not type full Aadhaar, PAN, phone or bank numbers. If you do, only the last 4 digits are kept.
drafts.reviewHelp: This is exactly what will be in the PDF. Fix anything that is wrong, then tick the box.
drafts.changed: You changed something after reviewing. Please review again.
drafts.failed: Could not prepare the PDF. Please try again.
drafts.notice: Fees, addresses and deadlines are not filled in for you. Confirm them on the official source before you send this.
